mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic growth that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of quarters when GDPC1 expands, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 330 signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 330, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a severe labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals aggressive policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises above 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.
